def solve_n_queens(n, fixed):
    # fixed: dict row->col
    cols = set()
    diag1 = set()  # row-col
    diag2 = set()  # row+col
    solution = [None]*n
    
    def backtrack(r):
        if r == n:
            return True
        if r in fixed:
            c = fixed[r]
            if c in cols or (r-c) in diag1 or (r+c) in diag2:
                return False
            cols.add(c)
            diag1.add(r-c)
            diag2.add(r+c)
            solution[r] = c
            if backtrack(r+1):
                return True
            cols.remove(c)
            diag1.remove(r-c)
            diag2.remove(r+c)
            solution[r] = None
            return False
        else:
            for c in range(n):
                if c in cols or (r-c) in diag1 or (r+c) in diag2:
                    continue
                cols.add(c)
                diag1.add(r-c)
                diag2.add(r+c)
                solution[r] = c
                if backtrack(r+1):
                    return True
                cols.remove(c)
                diag1.remove(r-c)
                diag2.remove(r+c)
                solution[r] = None
            return False
    
    if backtrack(0):
        return solution
    else:
        return None
